# Siddique Akbar Trust

> A madrasa in Nashik, Maharashtra, India, opened in 2024. It teaches Quran, Hifz, Tajweed, Dars-e-Nizami (the eight-year Aalim course), Hadith, Fiqh and the Aalimah course for girls, at low fees funded by donations. Registered name: Jamia Siddhiqe Akbar Ahale Sunnat Trust.

- Address: Ashrafi Chowk, Sanjiv Nagar, Link Road, Nashik, Maharashtra
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 8055108635
- Email: info@siddiqueakbartrust.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM
- Registered under 80G and 12A: donations from Indian taxpayers are tax-deductible
- Students: 150+ · Teachers: 5+ (all hold ijazah) · Separate department for girls with women teachers

- [Gallery](https://www.siddiqueakbartrust.com/gallery): photos and past gatherings
